title: Tamil Nadu government revises cooperative crop loan waiver up to ₹75,000; expands to all farmers
description: Under the revised announcement, a total of 8,33,773 marginal farmers, 5,16,183 small farmers and 93,548 large farmers will receive waivers amounting to ₹3,599.67 crore, ₹1,995.42 crore and ₹337.15 crore, respectively.
